facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹11.99 lakh cr, +20% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹95,625 cr, −2% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter: revenue ₹3.31 lakh cr (+30% YoY), PAT ₹29,550 cr (+34% YoY), operating margin 17.1%.
Revenue has compounded at 15% over 10 years, 18% over 5 and 6% over 3; the last twelve months (+20%) are running ahead of the 3-year pace.
Profit and revenue have compounded at a similar pace over 3 years (5% vs 6%).
Quarterly revenue growth has accelerated over the last four quarters: +10% → +12% → +27% → +30% YoY.
Operating margin is steady at 17.1% (18.0% a year ago).
Borrowings are ₹4.05 lakh cr against equity of ₹9.44 lakh cr: debt/equity 0.43× (was 0.63× in Mar 2023).
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 7.2× over the last twelve months.
Capital work-in-progress is ₹2.33 lakh cr, 20% of fixed assets — a large build-out not yet earning.
The cash conversion cycle has lengthened to 25 days from 7 in Mar 2023 (debtor days 12 → 20, payable days 91 → 84): more cash is tied up in operations.
Promoters hold 50.4%, +0.4 pp over a year.
Over 5 years, ₹7.55 lakh cr of operating cash came from ₹7.58 lakh cr of operating profit: 100% conversion; against PAT of ₹3.98 lakh cr that is 1.9×.
Free cash flow was negative in 1 of the last 5 years; cumulative ₹1.29 lakh cr, latest year ₹70,023 cr.
Capex ran at 12% of revenue in Mar 2026, about ₹1.22 lakh cr (averaged 15% over the three years before).

business.what: Reliance Industries Limited is a diversified conglomerate operating in digital services, retail, media and entertainment, oil-to-chemicals, and oil and gas. It generates revenue through the sale of products, telecom services, retail commerce, media content, and hydrocarbon production.

guidance.quote: we are well on the course to do exceedingly well in this year, Rs.80,000 Crores on the O2C basis.

claims.claim: Jio sees visibility of high teen growth for the business.
claims.quote: We are able to, in our minds at least, we see visibility of high teen growth for Jio

claims.claim: Retail EBITDA margins are down due to a conscious choice to invest in digital commerce infrastructure.
claims.quote: This is something that we have been consistently flagging... we have been building online presence. It has been coming on the back of a lot of discipline.

claims.claim: Jio's capex has started tapering down as 5G deployment is largely complete.
claims.quote: With the bulk of the capex really behind us, having completed 5G deployment more or less across the country... the capex has started tapering down.

claims.claim: Retail expects margin benefits from digital commerce investments to accrue from next year.
claims.quote: we are quite confident these will start giving us results next year where they will start being accretive to the bottom line as well.

claims.claim: The company is well positioned for the structurally changed O2C market.
claims.quote: I think the markets are fundamentally structurally changed, and therefore we are well positioned for that.

claims.claim: Retail EBITDA margin is down 80 bps year-on-year due to investments in digital commerce and dark stores.
claims.quote: EBITDA margin is at 7.9%. It is down 80 bps on a Y-o-Y basis. But if you recollect, last two quarters, Q4 was 7.9, Q3 was 8.0.

claims.claim: Jio holds a 78% market share of net additions in the Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) segment in India.
claims.quote: we have a 78% FWA market share of the net additions in India.

claims.claim: Reliance is the only Indian technology company in the global top 20 PCT rankings with around 4,500 patents.
claims.quote: We are the only Indian technology company, technology innovator to be in the global top 20 rankings and this has been a significant jump in our rankings over the last year

claims.claim: The company has achieved a production of 1 gigawatt peak of solar modules and is on track for 20-gigawatt annual capacity.
claims.quote: Already achieved a production of around 1 gigawatt peak of solar modules along with our solar cells, all ALMM certified. And we are on track... to achieve 20-gigawatt annual capacity

claims.claim: Jio has the largest 5G subscriber base outside of China.
claims.quote: That makes us our 5G subscriber base the largest outside of China, the single country operator.

claims.claim: JioStar is the largest content studio in India by revenue and catalog size.
claims.quote: Jio Studios is now the largest content studio in India by revenue, by catalog size, as well as with box office share.

claims.claim: Jio Platforms EBITDA margin improved by 190 basis points year-on-year.
claims.quote: EBITDA margin of 52%. We saw a 190-basis points improvement there, increase there

claims.claim: Retail revenue growth was 12% for the full year.
claims.quote: for the full year the growth is 12% and if you exclude RCPL demerger the growth would be even higher.

claims.claim: Refining freight costs increased 10 to 15 times compared to normal levels.
claims.quote: freight costs easily 10 to 15 times the freight that you normally see.

claims.claim: We have 65% share of 5G subscribers in India.
claims.quote: We have 65% share of 5G subscribers in India.

claims.claim: We have gained over 800 basis point market share in the last 12 months.
claims.quote: We have gained over 800 basis point market share in the last 12 months.

claims.claim: We are the first Indian manufacturing company with an international rating of A-.
claims.quote: And I think we are the first Indian manufacturing company with an international rating of A-.

claims.claim: On a contribution margin level, we are positive in quick commerce.
claims.quote: The only thing I would say is on a contribution margin level, we are positive.

claims.claim: Jio is seeing sustained growth in customer base with 8.3 million net additions in the quarter.
claims.quote: 506 million consumers that we hit in this previous quarter. We closed at 506 million. 8.3 million net additions during the quarter.

claims.claim: Reliance Retail is the first modern trade retailer in most tier 2 and beyond cities.
claims.quote: If you look at most of the tier 2 and beyond cities, when we enter, we are the first modern trade retailer in those geographies.

claims.claim: Jio has no immediate plans to change tariffs.
claims.quote: At this point in time those will happen when they will happen. There are no current plans to change anything on it.

claims.claim: Jio Platforms is not investing in data centers; capex is done by Reliance Intelligence.
claims.quote: JPL is not investing in data centers, so I just want you to be clear about that. The capex is going to be done by Reliance Intelligence.

claims.claim: Reliance Retail is at least three times bigger than the next nearest retailer.
claims.quote: our assessment is that we would be at least three times, if not more, than the next nearest biggest retailer.

claims.claim: Jio is the largest carrier of traffic in the world.
claims.quote: We are the largest carriers of traffic in the world.

claims.claim: Jio holds the highest number of patents on 6G technology.
claims.quote: We hold the highest number of patents on 6G technology already.

claims.claim: Jio is the world's largest FWA service provider.
claims.quote: 82% market share, the largest FWA service provider globally.

claims.claim: New energy ecosystem will start operationalizing in next four to six quarters on a full-scale basis.
claims.quote: we will start operationalizing this new energy ecosystem in next four to six quarters on a full-scale basis.

synthesis.one_liner: Reliance delivers strong headline revenue growth of 20% and a PAT of Rs 95,625 cr, but 12 guidance items remain unmeasured.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management highlights broad-based demand and sustained growth across business segments with strong operational momentum.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Trailing twelve month revenue is Rs 11.99 lakh cr (+20%), but PAT declined 2% to Rs 95,625 cr.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Capex is funding major long-term infrastructure and new energy ecosystem builds across multiple sectors.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Capital work-in-progress sits at Rs 2.33 lakh cr, representing 20% of fixed assets not yet earning.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Core operations generate robust cash flow to support ongoing investments and strategic initiatives.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Over five years, operating cash of Rs 7.55 lakh cr matched 100% of operating profit, with cumulative FCF at Rs 1.29 lakh cr.

synthesis.credibility: Management provides numerous multi-year targets for retail, new energy, and segments, but zero targets are tracked as 12 items remain unmeasured.

bull.point: Revenue growth has accelerated over the last four consecutive quarters.
bull.evidence: Quarterly revenue growth moved from +10% to +30% YoY up to September 2026.

bull.point: Strong operating cash conversion supports multi-year investments.
bull.evidence: Five-year operating cash conversion reached 100% of operating profit at Rs 7.55 lakh cr.

bull.point: Balance sheet leverage remains moderate despite heavy capital deployment.
bull.evidence: Debt to equity ratio stands at 0.43x with borrowings of Rs 4.05 lakh cr against equity of Rs 9.44 lakh cr.

bear.point: Net profit has contracted despite double-digit top-line expansion.
bear.evidence: Trailing-twelve-month PAT fell 2% to Rs 95,625 cr while revenue grew 20%.

bear.point: Working capital efficiency has deteriorated with longer cash cycles.
bear.evidence: The cash conversion cycle lengthened to 25 days compared to 7 days in March 2023.

bear.point: A substantial block of fixed assets remains unproductive.
bear.evidence: Capital work-in-progress equals Rs 2.33 lakh cr, representing 20% of total fixed assets.

watch: Whether capital work-in-progress of Rs 2.33 lakh cr begins generating earnings.
Progression of the cash conversion cycle beyond 25 days.
Updates on unmeasured segment targets for retail and new energy.
